WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT product_id, mth, qty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mth::DATE) AS month_of_year
  FROM monthly_sales
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
first_36 AS (
  SELECT * FROM sales_data
  WHERE time_step <= 36
),
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT f1.product_id, f1.mth, f1.qty, f1.time_step, f1.month_of_year,
         (
           (SELECT AVG(f2.qty) FROM first_36 f2 
            WHERE f2.product_id = f1.product_id 
            AND f2.time_step BETWEEN f1.time_step - 5 AND f1.time_step + 6) +
           (SELECT AVG(f3.qty) FROM first_36 f3 
            WHERE f3.product_id = f1.product_id 
            AND f3.time_step BETWEEN f1.time_step - 6 AND f1.time_step + 5)
         ) / 2.0 AS cma
  FROM first_36 f1
),
ratio_calc AS (
  SELECT product_id, mth, qty, time_step, cma, month_of_year,
         CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN qty * 1.0 / cma ELSE NULL END AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM cma_calc
),
raw_seasonal AS (
  SELECT product_id, month_of_year, AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM ratio_calc
  WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
  GROUP BY product_id, month_of_year
),
seasonal_indices AS (
  SELECT product_id, month_of_year, avg_ratio,
         avg_ratio / AVG(avg_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS seasonal_index
  FROM raw_seasonal
),
deseasonalized AS (
  SELECT f.product_id, f.mth, f.qty, f.time_step, s.seasonal_index,
         CASE WHEN s.seasonal_index > 0 THEN f.qty * 1.0 / s.seasonal_index ELSE NULL END AS deseasonalized_qty
  FROM first_36 f
  JOIN seasonal_indices s ON f.product_id = s.product_id AND f.month_of_year = s.month_of_year
),
weighted_reg AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         SUM(time_step) AS w_sum_x,
         SUM(deseasonalized_qty) AS w_sum_y,
         SUM(time_step * time_step) AS w_sum_xx,
         SUM(time_step * deseasonalized_qty) AS w_sum_xy,
         SUM(time_step) AS w_total
  FROM deseasonalized
  GROUP BY product_id
),
regression_params AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         (w_sum_xy - w_sum_x * w_sum_y / w_total) / (w_sum_xx - w_sum_x * w_sum_x / w_total) AS slope,
         (w_sum_y / w_total) - (w_sum_x / w_total) * (w_sum_xy - w_sum_x * w_sum_y / w_total) / (w_sum_xx - w_sum_x * w_sum_x / w_total) AS intercept
  FROM weighted_reg
),
forecast AS (
  SELECT r.product_id, 
         t.time_step,
         t.month_of_year,
         r.slope * t.time_step + r.intercept AS trend_value,
         s.seasonal_index,
         (r.slope * t.time_step + r.intercept) * s.seasonal_index AS forecasted_qty
  FROM regression_params r
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 37 AS time_step, 1 AS month_of_year
    UNION ALL SELECT 38, 2
    UNION ALL SELECT 39, 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 41, 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 42, 6
    UNION ALL SELECT 43, 7
    UNION ALL SELECT 44, 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 45, 9
    UNION ALL SELECT 46, 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 47, 11
    UNION ALL SELECT 48, 12
  ) t
  JOIN seasonal_indices s ON r.product_id = s.product_id AND t.month_of_year = s.month_of_year
),
annual_forecast AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(forecasted_qty) AS annual_forecast_2018
  FROM forecast
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT AVG(annual_forecast_2018) AS average_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM annual_forecast

         avg_ratio / AVG(avg_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS seasonal_index
  FROM raw_seasonal
),
deseasonalized AS (
  SELECT f.product_id, f.mth, f.qty, f.time_step, s.seasonal_index,
         CASE WHEN s.seasonal_index > 0 THEN f.qty * 1.0 / s.seasonal_index ELSE NULL END AS deseasonalized_qty
  FROM first_36 f
  JOIN seasonal_indices s ON f.product_id = s.product_id AND f.month_of_year = s.month_of_year
),
weighted_reg AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         SUM(time_step) AS w_sum_x,
         SUM(deseasonalized_qty) AS w_sum_y,
         SUM(time_step * time_step) AS w_sum_xx,
         SUM(time_step * deseasonalized_qty) AS w_sum_xy,
         SUM(time_step) AS w_total
  FROM deseasonalized
  GROUP BY product_id
),
regression_params AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         (w_sum_xy - w_sum_x * w_sum_y / w_total) / (w_sum_xx - w_sum_x * w_sum_x / w_total) AS slope,
         (w_sum_y / w_total) - (w_sum_x / w_total) * (w_sum_xy - w_sum_x * w_sum_y / w_total) / (w_sum_xx - w_sum_x * w_sum_x / w_total) AS intercept
  FROM weighted_reg
),
forecast AS (
  SELECT r.product_id, 
         t.time_step,
         t.month_of_year,
         r.slope * t.time_step + r.intercept AS trend_value,
         s.seasonal_index,
         (r.slope * t.time_step + r.intercept) * s.seasonal_index AS forecasted_qty
  FROM regression_params r
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 37 AS time_step, 1 AS month_of_year
    UNION ALL SELECT 38, 2
    UNION ALL SELECT 39, 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 41, 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 42, 6
    UNION ALL SELECT 43, 7
    UNION ALL SELECT 44, 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 45, 9
    UNION ALL SELECT 46, 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 47, 11
    UNION ALL SELECT 48, 12
  ) t
  JOIN seasonal_indices s ON r.product_id = s.product_id AND t.month_of_year = s.month_of_year
),
annual_forecast AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(forecasted_qty) AS annual_forecast_2018
  FROM forecast
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT AVG(annual_forecast_2018) AS average_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM annual_forecast
